_note: input_tokens is NOT a real Anthropic count_tokens response — cox-provider's tests run with no network and no API key (AGENTS.md D12). It is tiktoken-rs o200k_base's count over the same rendered text cox_provider::tokens::rendered_message_text/rendered_full_text produce, used as a documented stand-in ground truth for tuning the byte-heuristic constants in tokens.rs (see BYTES_PER_TOKEN/TOKENS_PER_SCHEMA_KEY/TOKENS_PER_MESSAGE). tiktoken undercounts real Claude tokens by roughly 15-20% on prose and more on code, so this bounds the heuristic against a proxy, not the real Anthropic tokenizer.
